english.note: This is the everyday choice for a light or reflection that flickers faintly and intermittently; it is the all-purpose spoken rendering.

examples.english: The sunlight on the water makes it shimmer—it’s so pretty.
examples.traditional: 水面畀陽光照到閃吓閃吓，好靚喎。
